retrieval_policy.current_job: Do not fetch external or restricted content; use only the supplied catalog snapshot and locally authored kickoff files.
later_jobs: Retrieve only through an authorized mechanism and obey access controls; do not bypass authentication, robots controls, paywalls, or other restrictions.
For every artifact, record the canonical URL, retrieval result, retrieval time, content digest, license or usage terms, and source revision when available.
Keep link discovery, successful retrieval, content validation, and official-unit classification as separate states.
Inspect content before adding dependencies or ordering; a repository, webpage, or normalized record is not automatically a course unit.
Quarantine unavailable, ambiguous, or restricted items from learner views and never expose secrets, hidden graders, sealed references, or another learner's work.
Preserve failed retrieval evidence and expand the graph only from validated artifacts.
retrieval_policy.fallback: If a resource remains unavailable, retain its blocked status and build no completion requirement that depends on it.
